subject: Bash: python3 - <<'EOF' (file edit)
reason: A Python script that edited RELEASING.md was high stakes and said Publish package to npm, because the text it wrote mentioned npm publish. A script fed by a heredoc is code: words in it no longer set the tier or the title. Scripts like this made about 15 false high-stakes cards in 2 weeks (titles Run command, Run SQL statement, POST request to URL, Force push).
